estilo: Stylised low-poly 3D illustration, flat-shaded soft facets, clean geometric shapes, soft cinematic light, restrained dark palette of slate blue and muted violet, light fog and depth, vertical 9:16 frame with calm empty sky at the top and calm dark ground at the bottom. The explorer wears a bright red jacket, a yellow helmet with a headlamp and a small grey backpack; the red jacket is the only saturated colour. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no watermark.
k1: A hillside covered in low jungle bushes at dusk under a towering dark storm cloud, the dark mouth of a limestone cave in the middle of the slope. A lone cave explorer, seen from behind, walks into the cave entrance. Medium shot, camera slightly low.

edits.k2: Same explorer, same red jacket and yellow helmet, same low-poly style and palette. Now inside the cave: a very narrow passage of faceted grey rock, the explorer crawls forward on his belly, the headlamp beam cuts through floating dust. No text.
edits.k3: Same explorer, same red jacket and yellow helmet, same low-poly style and palette. Now a side cutaway cross-section of the whole hill like a diorama cut in half: the grassy surface on top, winding cave tunnels inside the rock, blue water rising and filling the lower tunnels, the small explorer kneeling on a rock in a pocket of air above the water. No text.
edits.k4: Same explorer, same red jacket and yellow helmet, same low-poly style and palette. A flooded dark cave chamber, the explorer sits on a rock in a small air pocket, two scuba divers with bright lamps approach underwater from the dark tunnel, their beams lighting the water. No text.

movimento.k1: The explorer walks slowly into the cave mouth, storm clouds drift, bushes sway in the wind, slow push-in camera. Low-poly stylised animation.
movimento.k2: The explorer crawls forward through the narrow passage, the headlamp beam moves and dust floats in the light, slow tracking camera. Low-poly stylised animation.
movimento.k3: The blue water slowly rises inside the cave tunnels of the cross-section, the explorer looks at the water, locked camera. Low-poly stylised animation.
movimento.k4: The two divers swim closer through the dark water, their lamp beams sweep, bubbles rise, the explorer raises a hand. Low-poly stylised animation.
